title: Box on an inclined plane (test36 words)
about: test36 lines 1-6 as Whisper gave them: no angle and no push direction said -> W only, the rest symbols

lines.say: Imagine a box on an inclined plane.
And we apply a weight of the box in the 5K GING.
The weight of the box is 5kg.
If the weight of the box is 5 kg.
If you apply a pushing force of 5N.
If the coefficient of friction is 0.3.
